lines: "There's people keep a lamp going up on the north ridge. All night. Every night."
"Long Watch. Not people, an order. They reckon somebody has to stay human and stay awake or the whole thing goes quiet without anyone noticing."
"Sounds like a lot of standing around."
"It is a lot of standing around. That's the point of them. Somebody's counting the nights so the rest of us don't have to."
"The Ascendants think a lamp is just a machine that hasn't been promoted yet."
